root_cause.text: The commit_mutex was unnecessarily acquired in nf_tables reset handlers (for rules, set elements, and objects) to prevent counter underrun, but this introduced a circular lock dependency with nfnl_subsys_ipset and nlk_cb_mutex when reset operations ran concurrently with ipset list and iptables-nft set rules, leading to a potential deadlock.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states "circular lock dependency between commit_mutex, nfnl_subsys_ipset and nlk_cb_mutex when nft reset, ipset list, and iptables-nft with '-m set' rule run at the same time." The patch reverts the commit_mutex usage in the reset path by removing dedicated wrapper functions (e.g., `nf_tables_dumpreset_rules`, `nf_tables_getrule_reset`, etc.) that acquired the mutex, and instead integrates reset logic directly into the main get/dump functions without the mutex, relying on prior patches that made individual reset handlers safe to run concurrently.
